cohort: The study included 13,239 infants registered in the Swedish Neonatal Quality Register between January 2017 and December 2021, all born below a gestational age of 35 weeks.
finding: The study found a significant reduction in the incidence of Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) and culture-positive late-onset sepsis during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the prior period, despite the number of extremely preterm births remaining unchanged.
gest_age: Infants born below 35 weeks gestational age, with a median gestational age at birth of 32.8 weeks.
